name: Magic Nails & Spa
summary: A free homepage we built for Magic Nails & Spa, the #1 nail salon in Montebello, CA, modeled on Sundays, one of New York's top nail salons.
client: Magic Nails & Spa is a nail salon in Montebello, CA with 1,330 Google reviews at 4.9 stars.
challenge: Customers love it on Google, but it had no website of its own. It already showed up #1 for "nail salon" on Google Maps, with nowhere to send those people.
built: Its real photos in a full-screen gallery that slides on its own
Story mode on phones: full-screen screens you swipe through
Call, directions and the main action on every screen
A look modeled on Sundays NYC: a price menu with tabs, booking on every screen, warm tan and cream
result: A free mockup we built to show the owner what's possible. Tap the preview to see it.

name: The Set
summary: A music platform where independent artists release music, sell beats and merch, and keep 80% of every sale.
client: The Set is a home for independent artists. Fans stream new music, buy beats and merch, and find events, all straight from the artist.
challenge: Independent artists needed one place to release music, sell to fans and get paid, without signing away their masters to a label.
built: An artist store for music, beats and merch, paid by card through Stripe
A live feed of new drops and sales on the homepage
Pages for artists, beats, events, collabs and news
Plans and pricing artists can sign up for online
Installs on a phone like an app
News articles and Schema code so Google and AI can find it
result: Live at theset.vip and taking real card payments, with artists keeping 80% of each sale.

name: YK Entertainment
summary: A wedding and event vendor marketplace for Los Angeles, Orange County and San Diego.
location: Los Angeles, Orange County and San Diego
client: YK Entertainment helps couples and planners find and book event vendors across Southern California: DJs, photographers, caterers, planners and more.
challenge: Couples compare a dozen vendors before they reach out. They needed one place to see real work and reviews, and vendors needed to be found on Google in each part of the region.
built: A vendor directory with profiles, ratings and reviews
Photos from real weddings and events
A page for each area served, from Downtown LA to San Diego
A blog and a forum that keep the site fresh for Google
Clear buttons to find and book a vendor on every page
result: Live at ykentertainment.vip, serving couples across Los Angeles, Orange County and San Diego.
